name: Jonatan Pardamean Manurung
headline: Exploring engineering through physics and AI.
introduction: I'm a physics undergraduate at Universitas Indonesia, exploring practical problems through computational projects, materials research, and technology education.

experience.detail: Research Center for Composites and Biomaterials
experience.description: Supporting research through literature reviews, proposal development, and patent drafting, alongside practical exposure to composite fabrication and vacuum bagging.
Helping primary school students explore coding and robotics through guided projects, live demonstrations, and hands-on debugging.
Making challenging ideas easier to understand through tailored explanations, worked examples, and practice that meets each student where they are.

about: Physics is where I started. The questions it leads me to often cross into engineering, computation, and the ways we build things that work in the real world.

At BRIN, I'm learning how research moves from literature to the lab. As a tutor, I'm learning how to make technical ideas accessible. Along the way, I use projects to explore new tools, test ideas, and keep asking better questions.
